note: Problems the audit found that are known and tracked. An entry needs a reason and, where there is one, a backlog item (docs/BACKLOG.md). Entries may use * in screen, size, check and label. Do not add an entry to turn a run green: fix the screen or file the item first.

entries.label: Timeline
entries.why: The Back to Timeline button of the Slow call screen is 50 x 19 px. Found when the audit reached this screen (BL-483); filed as BL-492, not changed here.

entries.label: Payroll.Run*
entries.why: The bars of the lane charts are 8 to 10 px tall (the Slow call lane rule keeps the lanes this height). Found when the audit reached this screen (BL-483); filed as BL-492, not changed here.

entries.label: The part of the strip the big chart shows*
entries.why: The minimap box is 17 x 64 px on a phone. Found when the audit reached this screen (BL-483); filed as BL-492, not changed here.

entries.label: Open the release page*
entries.why: In this documentation screen the Glossary drawer is open and its scrim lies over the update bar, so a press on the link goes to the scrim and the audit (since BL-497 it asks the browser who receives the press) no longer counts the link's grown hit area. The same link is audited with nothing in front of it in x-update-bar, where it passes. Not a defect of the page.
